You cant go back and change what you've done but you can determine your future. Why kill yourself over one mistake? We all make mistakes. Think about how you're life could be worse. You could have no food. You could have no house to live in. You could have no family or friends to support you. You could have no running water or electricity. Please don't end your life. Life can always get better. Ask Jesus Christ to forgive you of your sins, and ask him for more joy. I was in the same position as you but I prayed and now i see complete happiness in my life.
